title: Simplify the Consumer Data Right so people actually use it
action: Remove the rules that limit uptake in banking and energy: let consumers share their data with third parties they choose, simplify onboarding for businesses, and make further changes only where uses are high-value.
why: Open banking was meant to make switching easier, but compliance costs are high and use is low, so the competition benefits have not arrived.

evidence.source: Harnessing data and digital technology: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: The Australian Government should commit to reforms that will enable the Consumer Data Right (CDR) to better support data access for high-value uses while minimising compliance costs.

evidence.source: Harnessing data and digital technology: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: within the next two years, enable consumers to share data with third parties and simplify the on-boarding process for businesses
